$description: Component primitives at web scale. A post that shows UI draws these at 2× on the mist ground: every px here doubles. Near-square corners, square icon caps, one shadow. Source for the Components board (brand/canvas/build-brand.mjs) and the carousel's chips and tables.

border.$description: slate-mid at rest, navy focused, magenta-deep on error, never heavier.

surface.$description: White lifts 1.2:1 off mist with no effect.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus: the gap in the ground colour, the ring in magenta-mid.

chip.$description: A token name or a query in a post: the field's look at text size. Plain: white on a 1px rule-paper line. Alarm: a 1.5px magenta line (post 3px); alarm, sure: magenta-deep fill with paper text. Query: mist, no line.

padding.$description: 9px 15px on a post, at the 36px text.

shadow.$description: The brand's only shadow: navy at 12 %, under an open list.

height.$description: Flush to the list edge, square corners. 40px when the row holds a chip at text size.

hover.$description: One row, the one under the pointer, as a full-width band.

divider.$description: rule-paper between rows; slate-mid at a head and between groups.

checked.$description: Navy fill, paper check; 1px slate-mid line when clear.

stroke.$description: One stroke, square caps, mitred joins. 3.5px on a post.

badge.$description: A ring marker (A, B, a step number): the one round shape besides a photo. Letter in Archivo 800 at two thirds of the ring.

size.$description: 48px on a post; 40px in a key.

border.$description: 3px on a post, in the ink.

bar.$description: A stacked bar on a post: 660×60, 6px corners, segments 4px apart, the label inside when it fits. Doubted outlined, sure filled.

helper.$description: 16px web, 32px on a post: the component floor.
